entries.title: Computing energy of a finite-energy signal
entries.description: apply the energy formula to a signal with finite support or exponential decay.

entries.title: Computing power of a periodic signal
entries.description: apply the one-period power formula to a repeating waveform such as a ramp or sawtooth.

entries.title: Distinguishing decay from repetition
entries.description: recognize that decaying signals tend to be energy signals, while repeating signals tend to be power signals.
